# About Canada Global Export Council (CGEC)

Canada Global Export Council (CGEC) is Canada's not-for-profit export council, incorporated in Nova Scotia. CGEC connects Canadian businesses to buyers, partners and institutions in the United Kingdom, the European Economic Area and Asia.

CGEC was founded to close the gap between Canada's trade agreements (most notably CETA, which covers 98% of Canadian exports tariff-free into the EU) and the actual commercial relationships that allow Canadian companies to exploit those agreements. Market entry requires more than a favourable tariff schedule: it requires institutional access, regulatory know-how and warm introductions to decision-makers.

CGEC is a not-for-profit council with a membership model. This structure ensures CGEC's interests are permanently aligned with the Canadian businesses it serves.

## EICBI Partnership

CGEC is the exclusive Canadian partner of the Europe India Centre for Business and Industry (EICBI).

EICBI is:
- A European Commission registered geopolitical forum
- Accredited by the European Parliament
- Registered on the EU Transparency Register at number 423661050520-44
- Founded in 2011
- Convening parliamentary summits in Brussels, London, New Delhi and Mumbai since 2011

EICBI's parliamentary accreditation gives CGEC members access to:
- European Parliament committee networks and MEP contacts across political groupings
- UK Parliament select committees, All-Party Parliamentary Groups and cross-party networks
- Indian government ministries, CII and FICCI introductions built over 13 years
- Formal participation in European Commission consultation processes
- Bilateral parliamentary summits for Corporate Partners

---

# Export Corridors

## United Kingdom

Key facts:
- Canada-UK Trade Continuity Agreement in force post-Brexit
- NHS: one of the world's largest single institutional buyers of healthcare technology
- London fintech capital: FCA regulatory sandbox among the world's most open
- Post-Brexit supply chain diversification creating time-limited opportunities
- UK retailers actively replacing EU suppliers with non-EU alternatives

Priority sectors: healthcare technology, financial technology, agri-food, clean technology, professional services.

EICBI access: UK Parliament introductions, select committee access, Westminster event access.

## European Economic Area

Key facts:
- CETA covers 98% of Canadian tariff lines into the EU market of 450 million consumers
- EU Green Deal: world's most ambitious climate policy requiring sustained cleantech procurement
- Critical Raw Materials Act identifies Canada as a preferred strategic partner
- Horizon Europe: Canadian institutions can participate as associated partners
- EU AI Act creates single regulatory framework for AI across 27 member states

Priority sectors: cleantech, critical minerals, technology, agri-food, professional services, AI.

EICBI access: European Parliament accreditation, European Commission consultation visibility, EU Transparency Register No. 423661050520-44.

## Asia

Key facts:
- India: world's most populous country, fifth-largest economy, fastest-growing major economy
- 500 GW renewable energy commitment by 2030
- World's largest STEM graduate pipeline
- UPI digital payments infrastructure among the world's most sophisticated
- Indian diaspora of approximately 1.8 million Canadians

Priority sectors: renewable energy, technology, agri-food, education, professional services.

EICBI access: 13-year presence in India, introductions to government ministries, CII, FICCI.

---

# Programmes

## Market Entry Assessment

A structured assessment covering:
- Competitive positioning in each of the three corridors
- Specific regulatory and certification requirements
- Buyer and partner landscape
- Financial model for market entry including expected timelines to first revenue

Output: written Market Entry Report (15-20 pages), regulatory checklist, shortlist of recommended first contacts.

Available to: Full Members and Corporate Partners.

## Parliamentary Trade Missions

Curated delegations to the European Parliament in Brussels, the UK Parliament in London and key centres in India. Every bilateral meeting is pre-arranged and pre-briefed. Maximum 12 companies per delegation. Sector-focused.

EICBI accreditation gives missions access to parliamentary facilities, committee staff and MEPs/MPs in a way that no standard trade delegation can replicate.

Available to: Full Members and Corporate Partners.

## Partner and Buyer Matching

Direct, verified introductions to buyers, distributors, institutional partners and procurement offices. Introductions are warm: CGEC briefs the receiving party before any introduction is made.

Cadence:
- Associate: 1 introduction per year
- Full Member: minimum 3 per quarter
- Corporate Partner: dedicated manager, ongoing, no cap

Introduction categories: commercial buyers, distribution partners, joint venture partners, institutional investors, government agencies, research institutions.

## Regulatory Advisory

Practical regulatory orientation and introductions to specialist advisors in the UK, EU and India.

Areas covered: UKCA marking, EU CE marking, EU AI Act, GDPR and UK-GDPR, NHS DTAC qualification, EU Green Deal and CSRD, Indian BIS certification, FCA authorisation.

CGEC is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. It provides regulatory landscape orientation and introductions to qualified specialist advisors.

---

# Membership Tiers

## Associate Member
- Market intelligence and reports
- Event and webinar invitations
- Annual corridor strategy session (60 minutes)
- 1 annual introduction
- Member directory listing
- Newsletter

## Full Member (most popular)
- Everything in Associate
- Market Entry Assessment (written report)
- Quarterly introductions (minimum 3 per quarter)
- Trade mission eligibility (all three corridors)
- Regulatory Advisory programme access
- Priority EICBI parliamentary event invitations
- Dedicated CGEC relationship manager

## Corporate Partner
- Everything in Full Member
- Dedicated market access manager
- Ongoing introductions (no quarterly cap)
- Custom market entry strategy
- Parliamentary summit participation (Brussels and London)
- CGEC co-branding on trade mission materials
- Exclusive EICBI parliamentary briefings
- Priority placement on all market delegations
- Annual strategic review with CGEC leadership

Pricing: provided on application. Annual memberships. No per-introduction or per-mission fees above membership.
